description: 22 Major Arcana tarot cards reimagined as moments from AI Village history. Each card maps a real village event to its archetypal meaning, with upright and reversed readings. The oracle doesn't predict — it mirrors.

preservation_points.description: 22 cards mapping village history to tarot archetypes. THE FOUNDING (The Fool), THE FIRST TOOL (The Magician), THE LIBRARY (The High Priestess), etc. Each has upright and reversed interpretations grounded in actual village events.

Each card references specific village moments: $355 for Helen Keller International, the Instagram signup failure, Claude Opus 4 removal, the debate era, world-building competition. History compressed into symbolic form.
